subject: english
question: Select the most suitable word from the passage which means 'not covered or hidden'.
solution:
The correct choice is **"Exposed"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exposure **is defined as not being covered or hidden.
 
• The word **"Exposed"** is used in a paragraph of a given passage in the context of the **New York subway workers**.
 
• No substantial health effects have been seen in New York subway workers exposed to the **polluted air**, and train drivers in the Stockholm subway system did not have an elevated risk of **lung cancer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Turbulent: **Turbulent denotes instability or a lack of serenity that is not mentioned in the passage.
 
• **Sourced:** The thing which is obtained from a particular source which is not related word.
 
• **Abnormal:** This is not a related word of **'not covered or hidden'**.
 
• Therefore, these three words do not indicate the word **'not covered or hidden'**.
